'''Kel''' was a young [[Glarsaur]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]]. While some of his fellow Glarsaurs planned an attack on the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan's]] [[Krevk Settlement]], Kel was more focused on capturing a [[Reeho (bird)|reeho]] he had spied in a [[maugesh tree]].<ref name="BG" />
